categories.main_business_segments: Iida Group Holdings operates primarily through six core business segments: detached house development (戸建分譲事業), condominium development (マンション分譲事業), construction contracting (請負工事事業), real estate leasing, hotel operations, and related businesses. The group is structured around major subsidiaries such as Ichiken, Iida Sangyo, Toei Housing, Tact Home, Arnest One, and ID Home, each focusing on residential real estate and construction, with additional activities in wood products, building materials, and property management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The group leverages integrated in-house processes for land acquisition, design, construction, and sales, emphasizing cost competitiveness and quality control. Key technological initiatives include the development of high-performance, earthquake- and thermal-resistant homes, the use of proprietary construction methods (e.g., IG Strong CB method for overseas markets), and the adoption of sustainable materials such as engineered wood. R&D also focuses on wellness smart homes, artificial photosynthesis for energy, and long-life housing materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The main customer base consists of first-time homebuyers in their 20s and 30s seeking affordable, high-quality detached houses. The group also serves investors in income-generating properties, condominium buyers, and clients for custom-built homes, renovations, and property maintenance. End markets are primarily residential, with growing activities in rental, hotel, and commercial real estate.
categories.geographic_coverage: Iida Group's primary market is Japan, with nationwide coverage through its subsidiaries. The group also has a growing international presence, particularly in Indonesia, Russia (wood and forestry operations), and the United States (recent entry into the Atlanta housing market). Non-current assets are mainly in Japan, with significant holdings in Russia and emerging assets in Indonesia and the US.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly downstream as a developer, builder, and seller of residential properties, but also maintains midstream and upstream positions through in-house manufacturing of building materials, engineered wood, and glass, as well as forestry operations in Russia. This vertical integration supports cost control and supply stability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening competitiveness in core housing businesses, expanding the business portfolio (especially in maintenance, renovation, and income properties), and advancing sustainability initiatives. R&D focuses on decarbonization (ZEH-standard homes, artificial photosynthesis), wellness and smart home technologies, construction process efficiency, and overseas market adaptation. The group targets 4% organic growth, 70% revenue from detached houses, and ROE above 10% by 2030.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of newly built detached houses and condominiums, construction contracting (including custom homes and renovations), property leasing, and sales of building materials and equipment. Additional income streams include real estate brokerage, hotel operations, and recurring maintenance services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Iida Group is the leading player in Japan's detached house development sector, with a broad product lineup and nationwide reach. The industry is highly fragmented, with many small and mid-sized competitors and low entry barriers. The group differentiates itself through scale, cost leadership, and integrated supply chains, facing competition from both traditional homebuilders and new entrants from the custom home and condominium sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated revenue was ¥1,459.6 billion, with operating profit of ¥80.5 billion and net profit attributable to owners of ¥50.7 billion. Total assets reached ¥1.85 trillion, and the group employed 13,748 people. The company has maintained stable revenue and profitability, with a moderate growth trajectory and strong cash flow generation, aiming for sustainable mid-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Iida Group emphasizes affordable, high-quality housing that is accessible to a broad segment of first-time buyers, combining advanced safety, energy efficiency, and durability with competitive pricing. The group’s unique value lies in its integrated business model, cost competitiveness, and ability to deliver homes that meet strict performance standards (e.g., earthquake and thermal insulation ratings) at scale. Sustainability, customer support (including long-term maintenance), and continuous innovation in housing technology further differentiate the group.
